name: machine-mermaid
description: Tiny mermaid-style DSL for ML architecture diagrams. Zero dependencies, SVG out.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --minify --outfile dist/machine-mermaid.js && bun build src/index.ts --minify --format=iife --outfile dist/machine-mermaid.iife.js && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
